scope: Diagnostic same atmospheric state RRTMG4 vs RRTMGP37; no forecast tendency or restart state updates
state: Retained day source65100s LW pressure/temperature/VMRs including all121 layers, native prefix59; surface/solar/albedos from corresponding day captures

arms.clear: all hydrometeor paths and CF zero
arms.liquid: same atmospheric/surface state, explicit deterministic CF1 liquid only in native layer30, LWP10g/m2 and effective radius21.5um; a diagnostic perturbation, not original WRF cloud sample

common_gas_contract: Same dry-basis VMRs and pressure-derived dry molecular columns. Reproduce native RRTMG4 pressure/VMR column formula at its REAL32 precision; pass an inverted molecule-count bridge to37 via optional gas mass. The bridge is diagnostic gas amount mapping, not host density/mass or UDM correction. Retain actual host mass/capacity separately. Verify actual4 exported COLDRY vs actual37 captured GAS_COL_DRY and gas columns.
common_surface: same Tskin, grey emissivity, visible/NIR direct/diffuse albedo, mu0, solar constant; Earth-Sun adjustment1; zero aerosol/ice/snow/rain/CFC
cloud_sampling: No stochastic cloud realization comparison: explicit CF0/1 replicated over each engine spectral grid. Distinct seed control does not imply paired partial-cloud sampling.
native_heating: retain original engine4 REAL32 K/day and engine37 default pressure-cpd heating. Common Cstar is retained native host constant-kappa capacity from source. Compare Q37-Q4 over Cstar separately from conversion terms; retain native arithmetic residuals.
executions: LW/SW x clear/liquid =4 paired processes, plus2 liquid seed controls; 12 engine calls total. One new caller object/link, reuse pinned WRF/RTE libraries, no WRF forecast runs.

predeclared_numerical_checks.RRTMG4_source_screen: 256*REAL32_epsilon*max(1,sum(abs(4 bounding fluxes))) W/m2 per layer; numerical consistency screen, not certified error bound or physical tolerance
predeclared_numerical_checks.snapshot: byte-identical common physical input before/after4/after37; input file unchanged
predeclared_numerical_checks.seed_control: CF1 identical outputs for alternative seed
predeclared_numerical_checks.failure: retain observed mismatches; do not alter coefficients, protection guard, atmospheric state or numerical screens to force output agreement
